ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the outer left wire, the bottom wire, and the lower half of the right-side wire are connected into the same outer wire; on the right vertical branch there is an 8 V voltage source, marked with “+” at the upper end and “-” at the lower end, and the vertical wire below it is marked with a downward current i. The upper left branch has a 1 A current source, with the arrow pointing left, and after being connected in series with a 5 Ω resistor it connects to the upper node. The middle black dot is the middle node; it is connected to the upper node through the upper 1 Ω resistor, connected to the outer wire through the left 1 Ω resistor, connected to the lower right outer wire through the right 1 Ω resistor, and downward through an 8 V voltage source (upper positive and lower negative) and a 1 Ω resistor connected to the bottom outer wire. Reasoning: According to the method, take the outer wire as ground, with potential 0 V. The lower end of the right-side 8 V power supply is grounded and the upper end is positive, so the voltage of the upper node at its upper end is V_T = 8 V. Let the voltage of the middle black-dot node be V_M. The middle vertical 8 V power supply is upper positive and lower negative, so the voltage of the node at the lower end of this power supply is V_M - 8; this lower end is then connected to ground through 1 Ω, therefore the current from the middle node to the downward branch equals (V_M - 8)/1. Write KCL for the middle node, taking the current flowing out from the middle node as positive: (V_M - 8)/1 + V_M/1 + V_M/1 + (V_M - 8)/1 = 0. Therefore 4V_M - 16 = 0, obtaining V_M = 4 V. Thus, the current in the upper 1 Ω resistor flowing from the upper node to the middle node is (8 - 4)/1 = 4 A. The current in the right-side middle 1 Ω resistor flowing from the middle node to the right-side ground point is (4 - 0)/1 = 4 A. The arrow of the upper left current source points left, indicating that in this series branch there is 1 A flowing from the upper node through the 5 Ω and the current source to the left ground terminal. Write KCL for the upper node; let the current in the right-side 8 V power supply flowing from the upper end to the lower end be I_s, then 4 + 1 + I_s = 0, so I_s = -5 A, that is, actually 5 A flows from the lower end of the right-side power supply to the upper end. Then write KCL for the lower-end node of the right-side 8 V power supply: the middle right-side 1 Ω resistor sends 4 A into this node; while the right-side voltage source actually takes away 5 A upward from this node; the remaining current along the marked downward direction is i. Therefore 4 = 5 + i, obtaining i = -1 A.

推理：按方法把外导线作为地，电位为 0 V。右侧 8 V 电源下端接地且上端为正，所以其上端的上方节点电压为 V_T = 8 V。设中间黑点节点电压为 V_M。中间竖直 8 V 电源上正下负，所以该电源下端节点电压为 V_M - 8，该下端再经 1 Ω 接地，因此从中间节点向下支路的电流等于 (V_M - 8)/1。

对中间节点列 KCL，取从中间节点流出的电流为正：
(V_M - 8)/1 + V_M/1 + V_M/1 + (V_M - 8)/1 = 0。
所以 4V_M - 16 = 0，得到 V_M = 4 V。

于是上方 1 Ω 电阻中从上方节点流向中间节点的电流为 (8 - 4)/1 = 4 A。右侧中间 1 Ω 电阻中从中间节点流向右侧接地点的电流为 (4 - 0)/1 = 4 A。

上方左侧电流源箭头向左，表示该串联支路中有 1 A 从上方节点经 5 Ω 和电流源流向左侧接地端。对上方节点列 KCL，设右侧 8 V 电源中从上端流向下端的电流为 I_s，则 4 + 1 + I_s = 0，故 I_s = -5 A，即实际有 5 A 从右侧电源下端流向上端。

再对右侧 8 V 电源下端节点列 KCL：中间右侧 1 Ω 电阻向该节点送入 4 A；而右侧电压源实际从该节点向上带走 5 A；剩余沿标注向下方向的电流为 i。故 4 = 5 + i，得到 i = -1 A。

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个矩形外框电路，内部形成四个网孔。左上支路有一个 1 A 电流源，箭头向左，后面串联一个 5 Ω 电阻接到上方节点。中间竖直支路上部是 1 Ω 电阻，连接到中央黑点节点；中央黑点向下依次是一个 8 V 电压源（上正下负）和一个 1 Ω 电阻接到底部导线。中央黑点向左、向右各有一个 1 Ω 电阻。右侧上方竖直支路有一个 8 V 电压源（上正下负）。右侧下方导线标有电流 i，箭头向下。

推理：按题目要求，对四个网孔都取顺时针网孔电流：左上为 I1，右上为 I2，左下为 I3，右下为 I4。右下网孔的右侧外支路就是标注电流 i 的支路，方向也向下，所以 i = I4。

左上网孔的上支路顺时针方向为从左到右，但图中 1 A 电流源箭头向左，因此 I1 = -1 A。

对右上网孔写 KVL。它包含与左上网孔共用的中上 1 Ω 电阻、右侧 8 V 电源以及与右下网孔共用的右侧中间 1 Ω 电阻。顺时针绕行时，右侧 8 V 电源从正到负，记为 +8 V 压降：
(I2 - I1) + 8 + (I2 - I4) = 0。

对左下网孔写 KVL。它包含与左上网孔共用的左侧中间 1 Ω 电阻、中央 8 V 电源以及与右下网孔共用的下方中央 1 Ω 电阻。顺时针向下经过中央 8 V 电源，也是从正到负，记为 +8 V 压降：
(I3 - I1) + 8 + (I3 - I4) = 0。

对右下网孔写 KVL。它包含右侧中间 1 Ω 电阻和中央下方 1 Ω 电阻，并且顺时针经过中央 8 V 电源时是从负到正，记为 -8 V 压降：
(I4 - I2) + (I4 - I3) - 8 = 0。

代入 I1 = -1：
2I2 - I4 + 9 = 0，
2I3 - I4 + 9 = 0，
2I4 - I2 - I3 - 8 = 0。

由前两式得 I2 = I3。又 I4 = 2I2 + 9。代入第三式：
2(2I2 + 9) - I2 - I2 - 8 = 0，
2I2 + 10 = 0，
I2 = -5。
因此 I3 = -5，I4 = 2(-5) + 9 = -1。

所以标注电流 i = I4 = -1 A。

对右上网孔写 KVL。它包含与左上网孔共用的中上 1 Ω 电阻、右侧 8 V 电源以及与右下网孔共用的右侧中间 1 Ω 电阻。顺时针绕行时，右侧 8 V 电源从正到负，记为 +8 V 压降：
(I2 - I1) + 8 + (I2 - I4) = 0。

对左下网孔写 KVL。它包含与左上网孔共用的左侧中间 1 Ω 电阻、中央 8 V 电源以及与右下网孔共用的下方中央 1 Ω 电阻。顺时针向下经过中央 8 V 电源，也是从正到负，记为 +8 V 压降：
(I3 - I1) + 8 + (I3 - I4) = 0。

对右下网孔写 KVL。它包含右侧中间 1 Ω 电阻和中央下方 1 Ω 电阻，并且顺时针经过中央 8 V 电源时是从负到正，记为 -8 V 压降：
(I4 - I2) + (I4 - I3) - 8 = 0。

代入 I1 = -1：
2I2 - I4 + 9 = 0，
2I3 - I4 + 9 = 0，
2I4 - I2 - I3 - 8 = 0。

由前两式得 I2 = I3。又 I4 = 2I2 + 9。代入第三式：
2(2I2 + 9) - I2 - I2 - 8 = 0，
2I2 + 10 = 0，
I2 = -5。
因此 I3 = -5，I4 = 2(-5) + 9 = -1。

所以标注电流 i = I4 = -1 A。

raw_record.original_question: In the figure shown, the current \( i \) (in ampere) is ______
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, the outer left wire, the bottom wire, and the lower half of the right-side wire are connected into the same outer wire; on the right vertical branch there is an 8 V voltage source, marked with “+” at the upper end and “-” at the lower end, and the vertical wire below it is marked with a downward current i. The upper left branch has a 1 A current source, with the arrow pointing left, and after being connected in series with a 5 Ω resistor it connects to the upper node. The middle black dot is the middle node; it is connected to the upper node through the upper 1 Ω resistor, connected to the outer wire through the left 1 Ω resistor, connected to the lower right outer wire through the right 1 Ω resistor, and downward through an 8 V voltage source (upper positive and lower negative) and a 1 Ω resistor connected to the bottom outer wire.

Reasoning: According to the method, take the outer wire as ground, with potential 0 V. The lower end of the right-side 8 V power supply is grounded and the upper end is positive, so the voltage of the upper node at its upper end is V_T = 8 V. Let the voltage of the middle black-dot node be V_M. The middle vertical 8 V power supply is upper positive and lower negative, so the voltage of the node at the lower end of this power supply is V_M - 8; this lower end is then connected to ground through 1 Ω, therefore the current from the middle node to the downward branch equals (V_M - 8)/1.

Write KCL for the middle node, taking the current flowing out from the middle node as positive:
(V_M - 8)/1 + V_M/1 + V_M/1 + (V_M - 8)/1 = 0.
Therefore 4V_M - 16 = 0, obtaining V_M = 4 V.

Thus, the current in the upper 1 Ω resistor flowing from the upper node to the middle node is (8 - 4)/1 = 4 A. The current in the right-side middle 1 Ω resistor flowing from the middle node to the right-side ground point is (4 - 0)/1 = 4 A.

The arrow of the upper left current source points left, indicating that in this series branch there is 1 A flowing from the upper node through the 5 Ω and the current source to the left ground terminal. Write KCL for the upper node; let the current in the right-side 8 V power supply flowing from the upper end to the lower end be I_s, then 4 + 1 + I_s = 0, so I_s = -5 A, that is, actually 5 A flows from the lower end of the right-side power supply to the upper end.

Then write KCL for the lower-end node of the right-side 8 V power supply: the middle right-side 1 Ω resistor sends 4 A into this node; while the right-side voltage source actually takes away 5 A upward from this node; the remaining current along the marked downward direction is i. Therefore 4 = 5 + i, obtaining i = -1 A.
